heroHeadline: Day 94: CJNG Deploys IEDs & Narcobloqueos in Tecomán to Shield Commander; Plan Kukulkan 15 Days; El Sapo Still at Large
heroSubtitle: Day 94 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). TECOMÁN, COLIMA — DAY 93–94 (May 26–27): CJNG gunmen ambushed Colima state police (SSPE) responding to a 911 call in the Caleras community of Tecomán — deploying an artisanal armored truck, AK-47/AR-15/.50-cal Barrett rifles, and 7 improvised explosive devices (IEDs). Multi-agency response (SEMAR, SEDENA, National Guard, state/federal police) resulted in 2 CJNG killed, 5 arrested (including one U.S. citizen from Atlanta, Georgia — transferred to U.S. custody via Interpol for homicide charges), and 2 state police wounded. CJNG simultaneously deployed narcobloqueos on the Manzanillo-Colima federal highway, forcing school closures across four municipalities (Tecomán, Manzanillo, Armería, Ixtlahuacán). Colima SSP: CJNG was carrying out 'a desperate measure to prevent one of their commanders from being captured.' Official tally confirmed by Infobae on May 27. EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 94: Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán ('El Sapo' / 'El 090') remains at large as Mexico's #1 CJNG enforcement target. PLAN KUKULKAN — 15 DAYS: Fifteen days remain before the FIFA World Cup 2026 opening match (June 11, Estadio Azteca, Mexico City vs. South Africa). 111,000+ security personnel deployed; Guadalajara (Akron Stadium, 4 matches) under heightened CJNG-specific protocols. MANZANILLO COMMAND VOID — DAY 18: 18 days since El Chucky's arrest (May 9), no confirmed successor plaza boss. CIAGATE FGR INVESTIGATION (Day 94): Ongoing — Mullin-Sheinbaum 'coordination without subordination' framework active; June bilateral meeting scheduled. SUCCESSION BINARY: El 03 (confirmed leader) vs. El Sapo (military wing, at large). DECAPITATION LEDGER: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested March 11), El Jardinero (arrested April 27; DOJ superseding indictment May 14; extradition suspended), El Güero Conta (arrested April 27), El Chipo/Jorge N (arrested May 19), El Cabo (arrested May 7), El Chucky/Manzanillo (arrested May 9), El Checo/Tecate (arrested May 13). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials. 47+ CJNG HVTs neutralized.
